digest.component_or_area: completion evidence banking observer and oracle
propositions: The 0707 dense-banking eval fails (responses_at_bank=[6,7,8,9,9]) because it counts only genuine model records (source=='tool') and ignores policy fallback snapshots, which fire on the 3-response bound per criterion.

Post-commit e1352535ace, the COMMIT_STEERING_NOTICE was removed, allowing batched governed evidence reads to execute without interleaved steering nudges, causing the model's genuine first bank to exceed the 3-response bound.

System-level boundedness is maintained: the policy's per-criterion bounded-fallback snapshots fire durably at intervals [2,5,8,...], but the eval's actor filter renders this invisible to the observer.
The operator ruling (2026-08-22) rescopes the eval to count all durable bank writes (genuine records AND fallback snapshots) regardless of source, excluding only seeded cache seeds.

The observer and oracle must be updated to reflect system-level boundedness: make_observed_upsert records first durable writes regardless of source; unit tests verify fallback-only, live-shape, and genuinely-unbounded cases.
No production code changes; validation is local replay through the real policy plus live confirmation on the next scheduled external-integration run.
